headline: Embraer shares fall after US proposes 10% tariff on Brazilian aircraft
summary: Embraer shares declined following a U.S. proposal to impose a 10% tariff on finished Brazilian aircraft and sugar exports. Brazil is currently considering its response to the proposed duties.
why: Embraer is a major global aerospace manufacturer; tariffs on its products directly impact its price competitiveness in the U.S. market, which is a key destination for its aircraft.

impacts.name: Embraer
impacts.why: Tariffs increase the cost of Embraer's aircraft for U.S. customers, potentially reducing demand.
